program.description: Path to the binary to be debugged

cwd.description: Directory to execute the program in

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the program

env.description: Additional environment variables to pass to the debugging (and debugged) process

stopOnEntry.description: Whether to stop the stop the program immediately after launching it

debugger.description: The type of debugger to use. CodeLLDB is the default and recommended adapter: it is downloaded automatically on first use and supports interactive stdin via Zed's terminal. lldb-dap and gdb-dap are also supported (lldb-dap must be installed separately and only supports read-only stdin in Zed's Debug Console).

console.description: Where to launch the program. 'integratedTerminal' (default for CodeLLDB): an interactive terminal so stdin works — CodeLLDB uses the standard DAP runInTerminal request that Zed supports, so this is reliable. 'internalConsole': read-only Debug Console; reliable but stdin cannot be typed in. For lldb-dap, 'integratedTerminal' uses its fragile FIFO launcher and frequently times out on Zed.

label.description: The label to use for the debug scenario
